verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity's own docs say it matches government-issued photo IDs with selfies, and a community user describes taking a selfie with in-browser image analysis, so the core selfie-to-document match is a first-party capability. Nothing in the pack documents liveness detection or defenses against printed photos, screens or replayed video, so only the face-match part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented liveness detection, documented anti-spoofing defenses against printed photos, screen replays and replayed video, details on match methodology or accuracy, and independent hands-on corroboration of selfie-match effectiveness.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, selfie checks match the live user to the document portrait with liveness detection — documented defenses against printed photos, screens, and replayed video

citations.quote: Match government-issued photo IDs with selfies
Verify government-issued IDs, match documents to selfies, and validate SSNs to prevent fraud.
